entities.summary: Michael Joseph Baxter is an American former professional baseball outfielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, New York Mets, Los Angeles Dodgers and Chicago Cubs. He was also the hitting coach and recruiting coordinator for his alma Mater, Vanderbilt University.
